note: OHAPP061268 - biscuit bib apron with leather trim and the Carmel Valley Ranch logo on the pocket, from the works order S-OH116297-Pt1 (JH 21/9/26). Built on OHAPP061203DEN; fabric PC9068 at 0.83 m; trims coded from Trim Master List 8 (the 30 mm bronze D ring is on the list as 32 mm only, the additional printed care label has no code; LEATHERHIDE is the leather's stock code). Logo image is the photo of the embroidered pocket from the works order; placement image is the apron sketch.

styles.name: Biscuit bib apron, slant pocket, eyelet detail for waist ties with leather trim — Carmel Valley Ranch logo
styles.desc: Bib apron · Bib top detail · Self fabric waist ties through large eyelets (fabric not reversed for this style) · Slant hip pocket set to left side as worn · Leather neck strap with D ring loop · No towel loop · Stud re-inforcement piece to back of bib · Leather neck strap and leather trim stud fastened · NO TAX TAB · Carmel Valley Ranch logo embroidered on the pocket pre-make-up
styles.lectra: Model FOHDENIM variant APP0612 — discard right pocket as worn. Cut in leather: 1 long neck strap, 1 short strap with D ring loop, 1 pocket strap, 1 short bib strap. Cut in multiples of 70; leather straps cut in conjunction with the aprons.
fabrics: Biscuit ref 2860 LAFCP300 300gsm 55% cotton 45% polyester (Utexbel) — rating 0.83M
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BISCUIT 08569 — cost per metre
Oliver Harvey 'Button' Woven Centrefold Label (32x80mm) — set 4 cm down from finished top edge, right side seam as worn

OLIVER HARVEY WASH CARE LABEL — 55% cotton / 45% polyester · 70° wash · 2 dot iron · P dry clean · do not bleach · tumble dry — set 4 cm down from top of right side seam as worn, underneath the OH woven label
Printed label set underneath the Oliver Harvey label: "REMOVE NECK STRAP AND ALL LEATHER TRIMS BEFORE WASH"
LEATHERHIDE — 1 long neck strap, 1 short strap with D ring loop, 1 pocket strap, 1 short bib strap — cut with the aprons, in multiples of 70
Set through the leather strap with studs to secure, left side of bib as worn (the trims list carries the 32 mm bronze D ring — confirm the size)
Male part set to the apron, use markers: 4 at top of bib for the strap, 2 for the short bib strap, 2 for the pocket
Female part set to the leather (use markers)
30E/R AB antique brass eyelets 30 mm — set to top of side seam, centre 3 cm down from top and 3 cm in from side seam finished; set to top edge of bib, centre 3 cm from side and 3 cm from top
30 mm ring for the antique brass eyelets
OH GREASEPROOF TISSUE 500x750 — one sheet plus an extra half sheet to cover the leather neck strap while packed
mfg: Set embroidery to the pocket pre-make-up (Carmel Valley Ranch logo, bottom centre of the left pocket as worn)
Make waist ties. Bag out ends. Edgestitch one edge. (Do not reverse ties)
Overlock top edge of pocket and lower edge of bib re-inforcement piece
Set eyelet re-inforcement pieces at each side of apron, right side of fabric uppermost

Neaten lower edge of bib re-inforcement piece (right side uppermost): turn 6 mm and topstitch 4 mm. Set piece to top of apron (wrong side of apron with wrong side of the stud re-inforcement piece uppermost). Note the piece is slightly narrower than the apron so it falls into the armhole turning
Double turn armhole and topstitch 6 mm. Single turn bib top to reduce bulk
Stitch down bib top and edgestitch all round
Double turn side seam and hem to neaten and topstitch 12 mm. Insert labels

Set pocket hem: overlock top edge of pocket, turn 1.7 cm and topstitch 1.5 cm. Set the pocket to the left side as worn, side of pocket 3.5 cm from the finished side seam and 24 cm up from the finished hem. Edgestitch in position. 2-stitch triangle at top of pocket to secure
Note: apron to come back after eyelets to have waist ties set. Set tie through eyelet 4 cm and stitch down to secure, join on the inside as worn. Box stitch 2 stitches wide to the width of the strap
fin: Set eyelets: centre of eyelet 3 cm in from side seam and 3 cm down from side seam
Set leather trim (use markers): attach leather D ring fastening neck strap; set strap across top of pocket, stud fastened; set short strap stud fastened across top of bib. Trim, check, press and fold
Tissue and set product label. Use an extra half sheet of tissue to cover the leather neck strap while packed
styles.tol: Tolerance ± 2 cm (skirt width) · ± 1 cm (across bib) · ± 1.5 cm (length) · ± 2 cm (pocket)
styles.variant: APP0612 — discard right pocket as worn; leather straps cut with the aprons
styles.brandPlace: Carmel Valley Ranch logo set to the left pocket, bottom centre as worn. Embroider the pocket pre-make-up. No tax tab.
